features: 【🖱️ Integrated Precision Touchpad】 Enjoy complete cursor control without the need for a separate mouse. The built-in multi-touch touchpad supports tap, double-click, right-click, scrolling, and gesture navigation, making it perfect for presentations, smart TVs, tablets, and portable productivity.

【🔗 Bluetooth Multi-Device Compatibility】 Connect seamlessly to Android, Windows, iOS, and compatible devices using Bluetooth HID protocol. Dedicated shortcut keys allow quick switching between operating systems for a smooth cross-platform experience.

【✈️ Ultra-Slim & Travel-Friendly Design】 Designed for portability, the Nano Pad Touch features a sleek ultra-slim profile measuring just 7mm thick and weighs only 212g. Easily slip it into your backpack, laptop bag, or travel kit for productivity anywhere.

【🔋 Rechargeable Long-Life Battery】 Powered by a built-in rechargeable battery with up to 28 hours of working time and up to 23 days of standby. Convenient Type-C charging fully recharges the keyboard in under 2 hours for uninterrupted performance.

【⚡ Multimedia & Productivity Shortcuts】 Access multimedia controls, volume adjustment, brightness control, search, task view, copy, paste, and playback functions directly from the keyboard. Ideal for office work, home entertainment, smart TVs, and mobile productivity.
